name: micp-instrumentation-qc
title: MICP Instrumentation QC | 仪器、标定、采样链与质量控制

tools.name: qc
tools.purpose: Full QC pipeline: unit check -> calibration -> control chart -> sample chain -> integrity -> QC report

tools.name: calibration
tools.purpose: Calibration curve OLS, LOD/LOQ, expanded uncertainty (GUM)

tools.name: control
tools.purpose: Shewhart control chart, drift / over-range / saturation / baseline detection

tools.name: sample-chain
tools.purpose: Sample chain, barcode (checksum), duplicate-ID and timestamp-alignment detection

tools.name: integrity
tools.purpose: Raw/derived SHA-256 hashing, append-only hash-chained audit log, tamper detection

tools.name: adapters
tools.purpose: Instrument export format detection + unit normalization
